operational_kpis.name: U.S. Dept of Commerce CHIPS Award ($M)

tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Net Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from Rigetti quantum computing systems (Novera QPU), Quantum Cloud Services (QCS), and government research development contracts ($1.41M in Q3 2026, missing consensus $3.68M by -61.68%).
tooltip_definitions.Cepheus-1-108Q Architecture: Rigetti's flagship 108-qubit quantum processor assembled from twelve 9-qubit chiplets tiled together, delivering the industry's largest multi-chip superconducting quantum computer.
tooltip_definitions.Median Two-Qubit Fidelity: Quantum gate benchmark measuring gate error rates; Cepheus-1-108Q achieved 99.5% median 2-qubit fidelity across the full 108 qubits, 99.6% on an 80-qubit sublattice, and 99.7% on an 8-qubit sublattice.
tooltip_definitions.CHIPS Act $100M Award: Definitive agreement signed with the U.S. Department of Commerce in September 2026 for up to $100M in non-dilutive R&D funding with a minority government equity stake.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: GAAP operating loss of -$33.19M in Q3 2026 compared to -$28.06M in Q2 2026 and -$20.55M in Q3 2025 as R&D scaling in cryogenics and microelectronics elevated operational costs.
tooltip_definitions.Research and Development: Laboratory R&D and chip fabrication costs at Fab-1 totaling $25.50M in Q3 2026 ($66.18M for 9M 2026) compared to $15.02M in Q3 2025 (+69.8% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Selling, General and Administrative: Corporate, marketing, and legal expenses of $8.55M in Q3 2026 compared to $5.93M in Q3 2025 (+44.2% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Net Loss: GAAP net loss of -$3.14M in Q3 2026 (-$0.08 per share), benefiting from a $25.3M non-cash fair value gain on derivative warrant liabilities.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Net Loss: Non-GAAP net loss of -$20.5M (-$0.06 per share) in Q3 2026, excluding warrant revaluations and $7.96M in stock-based compensation expense.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Burn: Operating cash outflow of -$17.06M in Q3 2026 (-$49.06M for 9M 2026), worsening sequentially from -$15.78M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Cash purchases of property and equipment of $26.20M in Q3 2026 ($42.60M for 9M 2026), primarily funding cleanroom expansion and cryogenic dilution refrigerator installations.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow (-$17.06M) minus capital expenditures ($26.20M) equals reported negative free cash flow of -$43.26M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity compensation expense of $7.96M in Q3 2026 ($20.87M for 9M 2026) to retain key quantum physicists and fabrication engineers.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Comprehensive economic cash burn subtracting CapEx ($26.20M) and SBC ($7.96M) from OCF (-$17.06M), totaling -$51.22M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Cash Runway Horizon: Cash and cash equivalents of $45.80M at September 30, 2026, requiring initial tranches of the $100M CHIPS Act funding to support operations through late 2027.
tooltip_definitions.After-Hours Reaction: RGTI stock dropped -6.83% to $11.32 in after-hours trading as commercial revenue fell short ($1.41M vs $3.68M Street consensus), despite landmark 99.5% fidelity validation on Cepheus-1-108Q.
tooltip_definitions.300-Plus-Qubit Target: Next-generation quantum processor roadmap targeting >300 qubits with approximately 99.7% median 2-qubit gate fidelity and ultra-fast 50-70ns gate speeds.
tooltip_definitions.1,000-Qubit Roadmap: Long-term architecture roadmap advancing toward 1,000 qubits with 99.9% 2-qubit fidelity, laying the foundation for commercial fault-tolerant quantum advantage.
